test_title: PYST 26: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Rohit was taught classical music by the most renowned master in the state Sri Sanath Maharaj

options.text: The most renowned master in the state Sri Sanath Maharaj was taught classical music by Rohit.
The most renowned master in the state Sri Sanath Maharaj taught classical music to Rohit.
The classical music Rohit learnt was from the most renowned master in the state Sri Sanath Maharaj.
The most renowned master in the state Sri Sanath Maharaj is teaching classical music to Rohit.

solution:
Here the correct answer is** The most renowned master in the state Sri Sanath Maharaj taught classical music to Rohit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **passive voice**. We need to change it into** active voice**.
 
• The object of the passive voice **'The most renowned master in the state Sri Sanath Maharaj'** will become the subject of the active voice.
 
• The subject of the passive voice **'Rohit' **will become the object of the active voice.
 
• The given sentence is in **simple past tense.**
 
• The **structure **of** simple past tense:**
 
 
• Passive Voice: **Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject.**
 
• Active Voice:** Subject + V2 + Object.**
 
 
 
• **'was taught'** changes to **'taught'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

**Correct Active Voice:**__ *The most renowned master in the state Sri Sanath Maharaj taught classical music to Rohit*
